title: Royal Carillon School "Jef Denyn"
axis: Local +X runs along the five-bay Frederik de Merodestraat façade toward Hof van Busleyden. Local +Z points westward along Sint-Janstraat toward the intersection.

nativeAxes.x: along Frederik de Merodestraat toward Hof van Busleyden

features.role: The separately protected corner house at No. 63.

identityStatus: Exact public-domain exterior already published on Qualla, cited historic protection record, native OSM footprint and Flemish 1-metre ground and roof surveys.

terrainContact.basis: Original Flemish DHMVII 1-metre ground sample at the public corner pavement.

notes: The Flemish heritage inventory identifies a two-storey, five-bay corner house and clipped mansard. The exact Qualla view shows the blue stone corner portal, white facade, sash arrangement, dormer and terra-cotta roofs.
